label: Formulated the critique of subjective instrumental reason in Eclipse of Reason and Dialectic of Enlightenment
description: Max Horkheimer formulated and introduced the concept of "Instrumental Reason & Eclipse of Reason", which became a seminal contribution in political philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in political.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Max Horkheimer's canonical writings.

label: Co-authored Dialectic of Enlightenment, fusing social theory, philosophical critique, and psychoanalysis to analyze the culture industry
description: Theodor W. Adorno synthesized Max Horkheimer's framework with contrasting philosophical traditions to produce a novel unified philosophical system.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Max Horkheimer's perspective to Theodor W. Adorno's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis era.

label: Directly influenced Habermas at the Frankfurt Institute, who later sought to reconstruct Critical Theory on communicative rather than instrumental grounds
description: Jürgen Habermas was fundamentally influenced by Max Horkheimer's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Max Horkheimer's perspective to Jürgen Habermas's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis across history into the Contemporary & Post-Structural.

label: Recruited Marcuse to the Institute for Social Research in 1933, collaboratively developing Critical Theory and the critique of modern authority
